arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a single transparent boss-feature badge for the Bounty Breakers sci-fi frontier game, readable at 65 pixels.
Input image 1 is the edit target and identity reference: the existing crossed orange/cyan pulse-pistol badge.
Primary request: preserve the recognizable existing badge identity, with exactly two crossed orange-left and cyan-right pulse pistols, the central red glowing gem, and the dark angular metallic shield. Add a bold saturated ELECTRIC CYAN energy outline/ring around the entire silhouette, with a few thick white-hot lightning arcs. Bright teal/plasma aura, strong clean readable silhouette, clear visual separation from ordinary orange/cyan loot symbols. The ring should read as a substantial continuous outer feature, not tiny scattered sparks. Preserve the two guns, their recognizable crossing pose, colors, shape language, and central shield.
Style: highly polished thick ink outlines, bold cel-shaded video-game loot icon, metallic bevels and clear color masses matching the reference.
Composition: one centered square badge, entire badge and electric outer ring fully inside frame with transparent margins, 1024x1024 pixels.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background, including outside the glow; no colored matte and no checkerboard baked into the image.
Constraints: no text, letters, logo, extra weapons, extra objects, UI, frame, noisy spark confetti, or cropped silhouette. Exactly one asset.

requests.output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/scratch/193538a31926/generated_images as /workspace/scratch/193538a31926/generated_images/exec-398db9d3-7c82-43be-9bd4-85aa9c8a9c65.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.

visualNotes: Recognizable crossed orange/cyan pistol badge and central red gem preserved.
Bold cyan outer energy ring and thick white arcs visible.
Generated RGB output contains baked gray checkerboard backdrop; transparency requirement not met.

arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original boss fighter portrait for the Bounty Breakers sci-fi frontier video game.
Primary request: an imposing original fully masked robotic warlord in gold armor, broad angular gold shoulder plates, dark gunmetal underarmor, and a single glowing red visor. No crown and no resemblance to an existing franchise character. This is the upper combatant fighting an opponent below him.
Style: thick bold black ink outlines, dramatic cel-shaded video-game concept art, angular faceted metal plates, hard-edged gold highlights, chipped painted surfaces, mechanical joints and dark inset seams. Match a gritty illustrated sci-fi frontier gunslinger game with highly readable color masses, as in polished comic-inspired character splash art.
Composition: 1024x1536 portrait, one tall upright upper-body character. Head near the top with a generous top margin. He holds one gold sci-fi pulse revolver in front of his torso with its barrel aimed vertically straight DOWN, near bottom center. The muzzle clearly points toward the bottom edge, not toward the viewer or upward. Show the full head and complete gun including its muzzle with margins on every side. Center the helmet, torso, hand and downward gun on the middle vertical axis for a narrow 1:2.5 display crop; keep all essential facial and gun information within the middle 60 percent of image width. Broad shoulders can extend wider. Strong imposing stance. One character only, one weapon only.
Background: perfectly uniform near-black solid color #0a121b across the entire background.
Color palette: dominant saturated metallic gold armor, dark gunmetal underarmor and red visor accents.
Constraints: one single portrait asset, no character sheet, no alternate poses, no text, UI, logos, frames, crown, muzzle flash, smoke, sparks, scenery, background gradient, or existing franchise resemblance. All head and gun muzzle in frame.

visualNotes: One gold armored masked robotic warlord with red visor.
Centered gold revolver points toward the bottom; head and muzzle fully visible.
Output is already approximately 1:2.5 instead of requested 2:3 canvas.
Background appears near-black, with slight pixel variation rather than exact uniform #0a121b.
